'''Urbax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who was a high-ranking member of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] and their associate [[Corso Riggs]] after being hired by his longtime acquaintance [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] to assassinate the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Police officer/Legends|lawman]] [[Miel Muwn]].

==Biography==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Urbax was a member of the crime syndicate known as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]], a criminal and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was a longtime friend of Urbax, visited and subsequently hired [[Gender/Legends|him]] to [[Death/Legends|murder]] [[Miel Muwn]], a [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]] [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] who had been chasing Skavak across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Urbax left to deal with the lawman in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in the [[Coruscant Spaceport]]. As with all Black Sun dealings, their meeting was [[Holorecorder/Legends|recorded]]. A [[Voidhound|smuggler]] and their companion [[Corso Riggs]], who had [[Search for Skavak|come]] to Coruscant searching for Skavak and the former's [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]], retrieved the holorecordings of the meeting on a tip from their informant [[Darmas Pollaran]] and learned of Urbax's mission.<ref name="Hot Pursuit" />

Urbax's men had surrounded Muwn in the hangar when the two outlaws arrived. Using the [[Sullustan Criminal Code]]'s Article 11607, Muwn deputized them, legally permitting the two to aid him. Together, they succeeded in killing Urbax and his thugs.<ref name="Hot Pursuit" />

==Personality and traits==
Urbax had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and fur, and orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He referred to the Sullustan Miel Muwn as a "little mouse", and angrily wondered aloud if he was either deaf or stupid after Muwn continued to order them to stand down.

Urbax readily accepted a job from his longtime acquaintance Skavak, though he gruffly remarked that Skavak didn't have any friends when the latter referred to the two of them as such, and demanded payment for the job up front.<ref name="Hot Pursuit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Urbax first appeared in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a minor antagonist in the Coruscant portion of the Smuggler class story.<ref name="Hot Pursuit" />
